name: Miletičova medzi stánkami
camera_position: in an aisle at the Mileticova (south-west) edge of the market (OSM Trhovisko Mileticova 48.15362,17.13693; Mileticova runs 320/140 deg along its west side)
evidence: painting: the low white market hall with its little tower ahead, the brick chimney (OSM man_made=chimney 48.15366,17.13666) ahead-right, a tall estate block right (the Gloria tower 48.15513,17.13855 stands NE of the market), the two-storey market-edge building with the passage (Pasaz Mileticova, OSM way 1163484294, NW part of the market) ahead-left
reference mileticova_market_stalls_hall_2017.jpg: taken from the street into the market with the hall tower in the centre and the Gloria tower right - the same NE view
OSM tram: Zahradnicka north of the market (stop Saleziani 48.15514,17.13397, NW); the tram to the centre runs west, then via Karadzicova / Americke nam. to Spitalska
the 1950s Mileticova estate (register S27) lies across Mileticova, SW, behind the camera

S25.to_S21.route: walk NW to the Zahradnicka tram stop, tram west
